analysis.one_line_summary: A curly-haired model showcases defined curls achieved with the WavyTalk hair dryer and diffuser attachment over energetic music and bold benefit text overlays.
analysis.full_description: A vertical social ad for WavyTalk featuring a young woman demonstrating the Turblow Pro dryer with curl diffuser. The ad opens with the finished voluminous curly look, cuts to unboxing and showing the pink tool, demonstrates diffusing wet curls step by step from ends to scalp, and concludes with the defined final result alongside promotional discount and CTA text overlays. There is no spoken audio; upbeat electronic music plays throughout.

on_screen_text.text: SEE WHY IT WENT VIRAL ON TIKTOK

scenes.visual: Young woman with long, voluminous, dark brunette curly hair smiling, running her fingers through her hair.
scenes.action: Posing and shaking hair to show off defined curl result.

scenes.visual: Woman smiling while holding up the WavyTalk product packaging box, then holding the pastel pink hair dryer with the diffuser head attached.
scenes.action: Unboxing and presenting the product and diffuser attachment to camera.

scenes.visual: Woman holding the dryer with diffuser cup lifting and scrunching damp curls.
scenes.action: Diffusing damp curls upwards from the ends toward the roots.

scenes.visual: Diffusing side sections of curls, lifting them into the diffuser bowl.
scenes.action: Gently pulsing the diffuser into curly hair.

scenes.visual: Rear/top angle showing the diffuser bowl pressed gently into the crown and roots.
scenes.action: Diffusing roots and back sections for root lift.

scenes.visual: Diffuser positioned along the top side of head near roots.
scenes.action: Lifting root volume with the diffuser prongs.

scenes.visual: Woman touching her fully dried, bouncy, glossy defined curls and smiling at camera.
scenes.action: Showing off the completed hairstyle, fluffing hair at the roots and posing.
